_comment: Owner-approved dependency-audit exceptions for the DEVELOPMENT tree only (decision 38); a production high or critical finding can never be excepted. Each entry: package, optional advisory (GHSA id), reason, added and expires (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 30 days apart). An expired or malformed entry FAILS the gate.

exceptions.reason: Development tree only (the glob matcher under vite, vitest, eslint and typescript-eslint; test and lint tools, nothing ships). GHSA-FC5Q-39XC-VJPF is a ReDoS on single-branch repeated extglobs in picomatch <= 4.0.7, and no fixed picomatch release exists (4.0.7 is the newest). The patterns come from the repo's own config, not from users. Added by the build agent in the V3 build (D-1774) so CI can pass; it replaces the braces-era entries that expired on 2026-11-20. — Owner approved in chat on 2026-11-18 (30 days, development tree only); it expires in 30 days.
